description: Aerospace Engineering prep student with a passion for space research and leadership. As an experienced team captain, I handle project management and task delegation. We are taking on the "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" challenge with an ambitious, driven team aiming to win and educate. Looking for teammates skilled in software development and graphic design/illustration to build an impactful solution together!
summary: We created a website that provides information about various rovers that NASA has launched in the past and whose missions have ended. The main purpose of our website is to make learning about space and rovers more memorable and fun for people aged 10 to 18.
details: It facilitates effective and interactive learning for individuals, who can access it through the website we created. It promotes lasting learning. Our project aims to help individuals achieve more lasting learning and become aware of the stages of development that humanity has gone through. We received assistance from an AI program named Claude in creating our website. We believe this is a very creative and unique project. Our team has based its work on individuals’ learning tendencies and preferences, as well as on effective and lasting learning methods.
